The '''LK Model Afterburner Array''' was a type of [[engine boosting system]] hardwired into a vehicle to enhance the performance of an [[Engine/Legends|engine]]. It was manufactured by [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="EV" />
